transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Hi, Doctor. It’s really nice to meet you. Thank you so much for fitting me in. 

Um... I hope I’m explaining this right, and I feel a little silly even taking up your time because I know it's probably not a huge deal, but... I guess what brings me in is that I just feel like I can’t quite settle in my own body anymore? I don't know if that makes sense. Like, especially when I’m supposed to just sit quietly and handle normal things, like household paperwork or sitting down to make shared plans for the house. 

I just get so... antsy. I'm sure everyone gets a little like that sometimes, right? But it's just been bothering me enough that I thought I should ask a professional about it. Is that the sort of thing you help people with?
When you need to sit down and focus, do you find your mind drifting off or getting distracted very easily?

Oh, um... yes, I suppose I do. I mean, I think it happens to everyone, really. It's so easy to get a little sidetracked, isn't it? 

But, well... if I’m trying to, say, sort through bills at the kitchen table, it doesn't take much. If my phone buzzes, or if I hear a car drive by outside... or honestly, even if I just suddenly wonder what I should make for dinner, I’ll kind of... go with that thought. And then, before I even realize it, I’ve completely stopped what I was supposed to be doing. 

I know that probably sounds a bit scatterbrained, and I really do try my best to stay on task. I hope that's the kind of answer you were looking for?
Did these concentration and restlessness problems start when you were a child?

Oh... um, wow. I guess I haven't thought about that in a really long time. But... yes, I suppose looking back, it really was already a part of me even back in elementary school. 

I mean, I know a lot of kids are a little disorganized, right? But I was always the girl with the, um, the really messy desk. And I was constantly forgetting my permission slips... which always made me feel terrible, because I really didn't want to be a nuisance to my teachers or my parents. 

And, well... they used to get notes sent home sometimes. The teachers, I mean. Just saying that I talked out of turn a bit too much, or that I seemed unable to just stay seated during quiet time. I was never trying to be disruptive or a bad student, I promise! I just... I guess I just had a lot of extra energy back then. 

Does that... is that the kind of childhood stuff you were asking about? I hope I'm answering this okay.
Do these attention and restlessness problems still happen in your daily life now as an adult?

Um... yes, they do. I really try so hard to keep on top of everything, I promise I do. But... well, to be completely honest, it's actually been noticeably worse recently. Or, well, since I got married, which was about a year and five months ago. 

When our routines merged, it just sort of... I don't know, it made it a lot harder to manage things the way I used to when it was only me. I feel so bad about it, because I really want to be a good partner and not make our home life feel chaotic or anything. But trying to coordinate everything together just makes me feel so much more scattered and restless than before. 

I hope it's okay that I'm bringing that up? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information, and I hope that answers your question!
Has this made it hard for you to function at work, at home, or in relationships?

Oh... well... I really hate to admit this, because I always want to be someone people can depend on. But... yes, I suppose it has. 

Um, at home, and in the volunteer groups I help out with... I think the fallout lately is that people just can't reliably count on me. I'll agree to do something, and I really, truly mean to do it, but then things just sort of... fall through the cracks. I actually had to step back from a few of my volunteer responsibilities recently because I keep letting things slip, despite trying so, so hard to keep it all organized. 

I felt terrible about it, I really did! I just didn't want to keep letting everyone down when I couldn't follow through. Does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining that the way you need me to...
